messages.author: d3aaa07872b9962c
messages.subject: Legend positioning
parts:
Hi,

I often use opts(legend.position=c(x, y)) to position a legend
somewhere within the plot area. Is it possible to control which part
of the legend is attached to that position? Currently it seems to be
the center of the legend, but often I'd need something like hjust and
vjust parameters to position the legend neatly in a corner.

-- Osmo

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Legend positioning
parts:
Hi Osmo,

You can use the (undocumted) option legend.justification, which should
be a character of length two of the form c("left", "top") or
c("center", "bottom"), ... It's passed to the just argument of
viewport() so see the documentation there for more details.

Hadley
